sloka: रेमे जनकराजस्य तदा प्रेक्ष्य सुता नदीम् ।क्रोशमात्रम् ततो गत्वा भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मनौ ॥२-५५-३३॥
transliteration: reme janakarājasya tadā prekṣya sutā nadīm ।krośamātram tato gatvā bhrātarau rāmalakṣmanau ॥2-55-33॥

translations.english: After walking a krosa into the forest on the bank of Yamuna, the two brothers killed many deer suitable for sacrifice and ate them.
